<DOCSTRING>
Convert unix timestamp to local time.

Parameters:
str_unix_timestamp (str): Unix timestamp (e.g., "1717715516")
str_timezone_offset_seconds (str): Timezone offset in seconds (e.g., "28800" represents UTC+8)

Returns:
str: Local time in the format "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS"
       Or message "API sunset/sunrise data format error!"
       Or message "API timezone data format error!"
</DOCSTRING>
